items.title: Why Are Robinhood (HOOD) Shares Soaring Today
items.summary: Shares of financial services company Robinhood (NASDAQ:HOOD) jumped 5.3% in the afternoon session after the company secured regulatory approval to offer cryptocurrency services in the United Kingdom and reported strong second-quarter financial results. Robinhood received authorization from the U.K.'s Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), a move that positions it for international expansion. This news followed a strong financial report for the second quarter of 2026, where revenue jumped 32.25% year
